_note: Voice-over artists for the commercials (ids = ad module ids in public/js/ads/). Kokoro blends kept apart from the presenters' voices (server/voice/casting.json) so an advert never sounds like the newsreader who just handed over. 'default' covers ads added later: picked by the ad's own voice.gender and voice.lang. speed is the Kokoro speed; every line must fit the gap before the ad's next script line (checked when the server renders them). 4 Oct: the correspondents (Rhea bf_lily+bf_emma, Vic am_eric+am_onyx, Mika af_aoede) took three of the free voices; the defaults moved off them (male-us am_liam+am_onyx: 62 from Vic, >86 from the presenters; female-us af_sky+af_river: >71 from everyone, Nova 56 before).

bitfizz-cola.notes: Whispered whisky-ad baritone: fable's plummy en-GB, darkened with onyx.

screechnet.notes: Film-trailer narrator, deep and earnest, read with British phonemes.

safesector.notes: Sombre insurance-ad woman: soft, sincere, unhurried. Owner 4 Oct round: bf_lily became Rhea Raster's voice (WORLD NOW correspondent), so the ad is pure bf_alice (measured: >84 from every presenter, 56 from Rhea, who airs only inside WORLD NOW's links).

cloudbrella.notes: Calm keynote presenter, Californian and airy.

corners.notes: Velvet food-ad voice: nicole's breathy softness with British vowels.
